The '''Gameplay Support Advocate''' was one of the six original Player Advocates of the [[Players Committee]], named on 25 January 2002. By December 2002 the seat was listed as Card Design (see [[Design Advocate]]).<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter from Warren Holland dated 25 January 2002)</ref>

== Holders ==

Each range runs from the month the holder is first documented to the month the holder is no longer listed, as on [[Players Committee advocates]]. Each holder appears once, on the row that gives their whole tenure.
